name: @myne/editor
//: Shared CodeMirror editor ENGINE — the frontend `core` to `@myne/dialect`'s `protocol`. ALL platform coupling (i18n, tag index, prefs, attachment import/catalog/picker/export/rename/ref-resolution, voice capture, open-URL, AI, spell) is injected through the `EditorHost` in ./src/host.ts. Phase B closed with phase3-web-client task 76: the six files that still imported `@tauri-apps/*` at module scope now call `getHost()`, and the two `@tauri-apps/*` peerDependencies are gone — this package has NO host dependency of any kind, which is what lets a third, non-Tauri client (the browser) compile it. `scripts/check-platform-seam.mjs` enforces that in pre-commit and in CI. Consumed as SOURCE by every client (Vite compiles it); the desktop keeps re-export shims in `src/editor/*` so its importers stay unchanged.
